name: trigger-menu
title: Trigger Menu
description: Opens caret-anchored suggestions when typing trigger characters like @, /, or # inside an input or textarea.

files.content:
import '@ui-sdk/web/trigger-menu'
import './trigger-menu.css'

export {
  createTriggerMenuController,
  textFieldAdapter,
} from '@ui-sdk/web/trigger-menu'
export type TriggerMenuInputSurface = 'base' | 'layer-1'
export type TriggerMenuItemProps<T = string> = Omit<
  BaseTriggerMenuItemProps,
  'value' | 'class' | 'render'
> & {
  value: T
  class?: BaseTriggerMenuItemProps['class']
  render?: BaseTriggerMenuItemProps['render']
}
